analysis_plan: Verify main/replay population fingerprints, fixed sampled identity-order hashes, baseline-policy target hashes, common offset hashes, prediction hashes, exact counts, and numerical metrics after normalizing only run-local paths and IDs.

For every layer and assignment, report intrinsic mapped-reference contrast, control and compensated baseline contrast, exact-zero feasibility and residual, baseline correction RMS/median/p90/p99/max, bound-active counts, and lower/upper-bound hits.

Verify that both policies use exactly the same identity at every physical address and, for each scale pair, exactly the same d tensor. Report common matched headroom, zero-capacity quads, and B, d, and G decomposition and bound residuals.

Report full four-cell loading plus row and column loading changes caused by compensation. No baseline term may be removed: all transfer, denominator, voltage, and accuracy diagnostics must be evaluated from the full G=B+d conductances.
Use assignment 86001 to select one calibration per baseline policy. On assignments 87001-87003, report the full two-by-two policy/calibration matrix and exact correct/10000 for each cell.

Treat local_min_l2_exact_zero@cal_local_nearest_symmetry minus local_nearest_symmetry@cal_local_nearest_symmetry as the primary fixed-calibration causal effect. Report the per-assignment values, arithmetic mean, and full range.

Treat local_min_l2_exact_zero@cal_local_min_l2_exact_zero minus local_nearest_symmetry@cal_local_nearest_symmetry as the secondary scheme-refitted comparison, with both cross-calibration effects retained as diagnostics.

Interpret exact zero without accuracy recovery as evidence that local reference contrast is not sufficient; interpret recovery only as an ideal continuous baseline result, not as evidence that the sub-pulse baseline corrections can be programmed.

arms.description: Primary native ideal continuous fixed-identity nearest-reference versus exact-zero local-baseline evaluation.
Independent native semantic replay of the exact local-reference compensation contract.

completion_criteria: Both native commands receive data/ibm_om_cell_aware_full_span_v1.pt (SHA-256 a99995a3e5b321a56bb7e00e29840c3b76f3fee95b8d8c80fdf0fa16e93b3563) through --weights and data/mnist_relu_teacher_fixed_init_20260816.pt (SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52) through --teacher-weights; the initialization derivation receipt is data/ibm_om_cell_aware_full_span_v1.receipt.json (SHA-256 d58b0d709312061dc2425d143744f45fdf9de9d5e583a619e7a91325c53059b8).

Both declared native validate arms complete from the frozen pre-BPTT checkpoint and teacher, cover development assignment 86001 and held-out assignments 87001-87003, and evaluate all 10000 test examples per held-out policy/calibration cell.
The sampled device identities and their flat physical addresses are identical between baseline policies; no identity, intrinsic r, bound, or other device field is reassigned or mutated.

All local exact-zero box projections are feasible, remain inside sampled active bounds, and have absolute signed baseline-contrast residual at most 1e-12 in normalized double precision before canonical physical conversion.

For every assignment, layer, scale pair, and logical weight, the control and treatment d tensors are bitwise identical after canonical physical conversion and are limited by the common headroom available to both policies.

Every selected physical branch is finite and nonnegative, every active branch is within its sampled bounds, every mapping records rho, bounds, B, d, and G with zero decomposition residual, and the full G enters both four-rail contrast and denominator loading.
Optimizer updates, quantization, pulse programming, HWA, deployment write noise, inference read noise, retention, and drift are exactly absent.

The mechanistic accuracy gate passes only if the primary fixed-control-calibration held-out mean improvement is at least 5 percentage points. The absolute recovery gate passes only if the treatment scheme-refitted held-out mean accuracy is at least 90 percent. Any failed gate is retained and interpreted rather than repaired after inspection.
hypothesis: With sampled identities fixed at their existing four-cell addresses, programming the nearest in-bounds local baseline whose signed four-rail contrast is exactly zero will improve held-out ideal continuous initialization by at least 5 percentage points under the frozen control calibration and recover at least 90 percent under per-scheme refitting.
motivation: Global within-layer reference-balanced identity assignment reduced the reference contrast by roughly two orders of magnitude and improved held-out ideal initialization, but that nonlocal reassignment is not a physically local deployment strategy. This study isolates the physically local baseline candidate before any programmability claim: it leaves intrinsic device r and all physical identities fixed, makes the smallest in-bounds local baseline correction needed for exact logical zero, and matches all positive weight offsets across policies.
title: Fixed-identity local exact-zero reference compensation at ideal initialization
